name: Launchpad
description: The most comprehensive agentic coding harness for Claude Code that works for both greenfield and brownfield projects. Drops 38 slash commands, 36 sub-agents, and 16 skills into any repo to give Claude Code full project context, run it through structured shape → plan → build → review → ship loops, and enforce multi-agent quality gates before any change reaches main. Works in any existing TypeScript, Python, Go, Django, or polyglot repo — install the plugin and run /lp-kickoff to start.
longDescription:
Ships **16 skills**, **6 agents** and **43 commands**.

- **Skills** (16): `lp-brainstorming` (Process skill for structured brainstorming sessions), `lp-compound-docs` (Process skill for structured problem documentation), `lp-creating-agents` (Creates new Claude Code agents or converts existing skills into agents), `lp-creating-skills` (Creates new Claude Code skills using the 7-phase Meta-Skill Forge methodology), `lp-document-review` (Process skill for reviewing and refining brainstorm or plan documents), `lp-frontend-design` (Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality), `lp-imgup` (Lightweight image hosting for quick sharing), `lp-prd` (Generate a Product Requirements Document (PRD) for a new feature), and 8 more
- **Agents** (6): `design`, `document-review`, `research`, `resolve`, `review`, `skills`
- **Commands** (43): `lp-bootstrap` (Materialize the v2.1 34-path infrastructure overlay (v2.1.5+) from sealed identity), `lp-brainstorm` (Collaborative brainstorming with codebase research, structured dialogue, and design document capture), `lp-build` (Meta-orchestrator for autonomous execution pipeline), `lp-commit` (Stage changes, run quality gates, generate a conventional commit message, and optionally create a PR with CI monitoring), `lp-copy-review` (Dispatches copy review agents from review_copy_agents in agents.yml), `lp-copy` (Reads copy brief from section spec and provides copy context for design builds), `lp-create-agent` (Create a new Claude Code agent or convert an existing skill into an agent), `lp-create-skill` (Create a new Claude Code skill using the 7-phase Meta-Skill Forge methodology), and 35 more

Installs with `claude plugin install launchpad@claude-community` from `builtform/launchpad` (`plugins/launchpad`).
